{{Quote|Good thing for me these guys are sloppy. Karrde would've had 'em shot. Now, to find Kaerobani's collection.|Mara Jade, in Kaerobani's base|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
'''Kaerobani''', a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a renowned [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Crime lord/Legends|kingpin]] during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] rise.<ref name="MOTS" /> In spite of his youth,<ref name="CWSE">{{CSWECite|II|191|Kaerobani}}</ref> he lead the [[Lumini pirates/Legends|Lumini Pirates]] on successful raids and gained the service of many [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]]. He resided on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rathalay]] in a massive [[Kaerobani's base|fortress]], complete with [[Hangar/Legends|hangars]], [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], and market areas. The fortress featured multiple common areas including a trophy room.<ref name="MOTS" /> Obsessed with rare antiquities,<ref name="CWSE" /> Kaerobani owned a number of pieces including a [[Phase II Dark Trooper/Legends|dark trooper]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]] and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[8t88/Legends|8t88's]] head. In orbit, Kaerobani also operated [[Orbiting Ship Yards|shipyards]] where his pirates could drop off raided goods and launch from on new missions.<ref name="MOTS" />

[[File:OrbitingShipYards.png|thumb|left|200px|Kaerobani's crew moving recently stolen cargo on their space station.]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC">According to the opening crawl, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'' takes place five [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]] after the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''Jedi Knight'' to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. Therefore, ''Mysteries of the Sith'' takes place in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]].</ref> his pirates attacked a New Republic [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], utilizing a [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Interdictor cruiser's]] [[Gravity well projector/Legends|gravity well projectors]] to hold it in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and steal its cargo, which included a [[Jedi holocron/Legends|holocron]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] served onboard and repelled the pirates. However, Kaerobani's men had already taken [[Kaerobani's holocron|holocron]], so Jade snuck aboard to retrieve it. She infiltrated Kaerobani's fortress, reclaimed the holocron, and escaped,<ref name="MOTS" /> all before Kaerobani could discern the artifact's mysteries.<ref name="CWSE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Kaerobani.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Kaerobani only physically appears in ''Mysteries of the Sith''{{'s}} manual and multiplayer mode]]
{{Quote|The dread pirate Kaerobani (and that's me being clever with the word Caribbean) steals a Sith holocron and Mara has to chase him to his hideout.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
Kaerobani is mentioned in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]'', however the character's model appeared as a multiplayer skin, voiced by [[Roger Jackson]].<ref name="MOTS" /> Level designer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] named the character after the word "Caribbean". He also misidentified the holocron Kaerobani stole as a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] holocron in his retrospective blog post.<ref name="Blog" /> The reference book ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' also continues this error while adding the additional element of Kaerobani stealing it from a facility on the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] rather than a corvette in unsafe space.<ref name="CWSE" />

In an unpublished story by [[Daniel Wallace]], a now-reformed Kaerobani was to have befriended retired [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant|Grant]]. When the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] attacked Rathalay, Kaerobani's 8t88 head would have aided Grant in defending the planet.<ref name="TFN">{{JCFCite|url=posts/24396345|board=Literature|thread=New Essential Guide to Droids|user=[[Daniel Wallace|Dan Wallace]]|date=2006-07-17|time=2:36 PM}}</ref>
